note_en: A 跟 B (不)一样 is the basic frame for "the same as / different from": 爸妈跟我的想法很不一样 "my parents think very differently from me"; 小婷跟他们想的一样 "Xiaoting thinks the same way they do." English switches between "like," "the same as," and "different from," but Chinese always uses 跟 + the thing compared + 一样 / 不一样. At the end Dad says: 你们这一代的安全感，跟我们的本来就不一样 "your generation's sense of security was never the same as ours."
